promptTemplate: A completely empty, windowless underground commercial corridor immediately after a sudden electrical power failure. The corridor is predominantly dark. Every normal fluorescent ceiling fixture is completely switched off; no white ceiling lamp is illuminated anywhere. Storefront lights are dark. All digital advertising screens are completely black. Escalator indicators and control lights are off. Only a few dim red emergency lamps remain powered, casting weak red reflections across the dark corridor. The obvious subject of the image is the sudden loss of electricity.
A cold heavy rain over an empty urban road with pooled water and reflective pavement, no clear people.
A public broadcast speaker, monitoring screens and an amber warning light in an abandoned civic room; no readable screen text and no coordinates.
An empty hospital corridor with a red medical alert lamp, clean abandoned equipment and a restrained urgent mood.
A research facility with malfunctioning instruments, flickering blue-violet emergency lights and a contained technical anomaly; no monsters.
A distant urban unrest atmosphere with small fires, temporary barricades and a muted city skyline; no battlefield, no identifiable people, no logos.
